provisional.title: Provisional round values pending the Fourth IMO GHG Study 2020 activity tables (days at sea by ship type)

assume.title: Modelling assumption of this application (no official value yet); documented in docs/decisions/0005

sea_days.note: Typical days at sea per year. EU share of activity = MRV time at sea ÷ (days × 24), capped at 100%.

uncertainty.note: ± share applied to the typical days at sea in the uncertainty analysis.

eu_dominant_threshold.note: At or above this EU share, the ship is treated as trading mainly in the EU and no estimate is needed.
